description: This file defines classes and functions related to setting up and managing vhost user input devices in a virtualized environment, including socket creation, command generation, and device configuration for input devices like touchscreen, touchpad, mouse, and switches.

classes.name: DeviceSockets
classes.description: Holds socket file descriptors for a single vhost user input device process, including device end, streamer end, and vhost user server socket.

classes.name: VhostInputDevices
classes.description: Creates and manages vhost user input device commands and socket connections, including touchscreen, touchpad, mouse, and switches, for virtual machine input configuration.

methods.name: NewDeviceSockets
methods.description: Creates a pair of connected sockets for device and streamer ends, and a local server socket for vhost user communication.

methods.name: NewVhostUserInputCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command to launch a vhost user input device with specified sockets and configuration.

methods.name: BuildTouchSpec
methods.description: Builds a device specification string for touch input devices by replacing placeholders in a template.
